basic_profile.bio: A 32-year-old MMO enthusiast from Toronto, Canada. I have been playing Tibia since my high school days and am passionate about old-school MMORPGs. I work as a software developer and often find myself coding late into the night, which coincidentally aligns with my preference for late-night gaming sessions. I’m currently single, enjoy hiking on weekends, and have a keen interest in bioethics, which I explore through academic articles and discussions online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have developed a strong foundation in programming and software development through both academic and practical experiences. My interest in bioethics stems from elective courses I took during university, and I continue to educate myself through books and online resources.
